# hirepulse

> Selected HirePulse data tools (Apify Actors). Each returns clean JSON and can be called by AI agents through the Apify MCP server. Higher Apify plans get volume discounts.

## Connect

- Remote MCP server: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/<tool-id>`; several tools are comma-separated.
- Authentication: OAuth in the browser, or the header `Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>`.
- Local (stdio): `npx -y @apify/actors-mcp-server --tools hirepulse/<tool-id>`, with `APIFY_TOKEN` in `env`.
- REST: `POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/hirepulse~<tool-id>/run-sync-get-dataset-items?maxTotalChargeUsd=0.10&restartOnError=false` with the input as the JSON body and `Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>` in the header. Start with one query or domain.
- Billing depends on the tool and delivered events; see its price and free-plan limits. Actor-start charges also apply. Inspect an existing run after a timeout before retrying a paid request.

## AliExpress Search Scraper (`hirepulse/aliexpress-search-scraper`)

**Use it when:** You need AliExpress search results for a keyword as JSON: title, price in a chosen currency, original price, discount, rating, units sold, image and product link.

**Not for:** Store or seller names, shipping costs or delivery estimates, reviews or stock. The tool does not return them.

- MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/aliexpress-search-scraper`
- Apify Store: https://apify.com/hirepulse/aliexpress-search-scraper
- Page: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/aliexpress-search-api/
- Price: $2.50 per 1,000 products. Free Apify plan: 100 products per run.

### Input

| Field | Type | Required / default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `queries` | array of strings | required | Search terms, for example ["wireless earbuds"]. |
| `max_results_per_query` | integer | default 60 | 60 products per page. |
| `sort` | string | default "best_match" | best_match, orders, price_low or price_high. |
| `currency` | string | default "USD" | For example USD, EUR, GBP or ILS. |
| `ship_to` | string | default "US" | Ship-to country code. |
| `min_price` | integer | optional | Lowest price. |
| `max_price` | integer | optional | Highest price. |

Example input:

```json
{
  "queries": [
    "wireless earbuds"
  ],
  "max_results_per_query": 120,
  "ship_to": "US",
  "currency": "USD"
}
```

### Output example

First record of a real test run (search "wireless earbuds", October 15, 2026):

```json
{
  "query": "wireless earbuds",
  "position": 1,
  "title": "TWS True Wireless Stereo Headset Touch Contro With Charging Case Wireless Earphones  In-ear Smart Earbuds  With Microphone",
  "url": "https://www.aliexpress.com/item/3256812924699567.html",
  "image_url": "https://ae-pic-a1.aliexpress-media.com/kf/Sb52dc1abf75e4777a2df3294034572d2X.jpg",
  "price": 7.89,
  "original_price": 15.78,
  "discount_percent": 50,
  "currency": "USD",
  "rating": 4.9,
  "sold": 919,
  "sold_text": "900+ sold",
  "is_sponsored": false,
  "listed_since": "2026-09-03",
  "ship_to": "US",
  "scraped_at": "2026-10-15T10:56:10Z"
}
```

## Google Ads Transparency Scraper (`hirepulse/google-ads-transparency-scraper`)

**Use it when:** You need the Google ads a company runs, by domain: advertiser, verified flag, format (text, image or video), first and last shown dates, preview image and Transparency Center link.

- MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/google-ads-transparency-scraper`
- Apify Store: https://apify.com/hirepulse/google-ads-transparency-scraper
- Page: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/google-ads-transparency-api/
- Price: $0.005 per domain + $0.0015 per ad. Domains with no ads cost $0.

### Input

| Field | Type | Required / default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `domains` | array of strings | required | Company domains, for example ["nike.com"]. |
| `mode` | string | default "ads" | ads or summary (one row per domain). |
| `max_ads_per_domain` | integer | default 40 |  |
| `country` | string | optional | Country code. |
| `platform` | string | default "all" | all, google_search, youtube, google_shopping, google_play or google_maps. |
| `format` | string | default "all" | all, text, image or video. |
| `date_from` | string | optional | Start date. |
| `date_to` | string | optional | End date. |
| `only_new_ads` | boolean | default false | Monitoring: return only ads not seen in earlier runs. |

Example input:

```json
{
  "domains": [
    "nike.com"
  ],
  "country": "US",
  "max_ads_per_domain": 40,
  "mode": "ads"
}
```

### Output example

Selected fields of one record from a real test run:

```json
{
  "domain": "nike.com",
  "advertiser_name": "Nike, Inc.",
  "advertiser_verified": true,
  "format": "text",
  "first_shown": "2023-11-16T21:51:37Z",
  "last_shown": "2026-10-14T15:10:53Z",
  "days_running": 1062
}
```

## Company Intent Radar (`hirepulse/company-intent-radar`)

**Use it when:** You need one report per company domain: open jobs and new jobs in the last 30 days, Google ads running now and in total, organic traffic and SEO trend, email provider from MX records, a 0-100 intent score and a one-line summary.

**Not for:** The full list of a company's jobs (use hirepulse/ats-job-pulse for that).

- MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/company-intent-radar`
- Apify Store: https://apify.com/hirepulse/company-intent-radar
- Page: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/company-intent-signals-api/
- Price: $0.03 per company report, charged only when the full report was produced. Free plan: hiring and email signals for 5 companies.

### Input

| Field | Type | Required / default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `domains` | array of strings | required | Company domains, for example ["stripe.com"]. |
| `country` | string | default "US" | Country code. |
| `include_jobs` | boolean | default false | Also return the job list. |

Example input:

```json
{
  "domains": [
    "stripe.com",
    "notion.so"
  ],
  "country": "US"
}
```

### Output example

Selected fields of one record from a real test run:

```json
{
  "domain": "stripe.com",
  "intent_score": 85,
  "open_jobs": 727,
  "ads_running_now": true,
  "email_provider": "Google Workspace"
}
```

## ATS Job Scraper (`hirepulse/ats-job-pulse`)

**Use it when:** You need every open job from a company's Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee or SmartRecruiters board. Pass a domain such as stripe.com or a board slug.

**Not for:** Companies on Workday or custom career sites.

- MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/ats-job-pulse`
- Apify Store: https://apify.com/hirepulse/ats-job-pulse
- Page: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/ats-jobs-api/
- Price: $0.05 per company whose job board was found and processed, however many jobs it has. Companies that are not found, and failed ones, are not charged.

### Input

| Field | Type | Required / default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `companies` | array of strings | required | Company domains or board slugs, for example ["stripe.com"]. |
| `output_mode` | string | default "jobs_and_summary" | jobs_and_summary, summary_only or jobs_only. |
| `track_diff` | boolean | default true | Mark new and closed jobs between runs. |
| `only_changes` | boolean | default false | Return only changes since the last run. |
| `extract_tech_keywords` | boolean | default true | Detect technologies mentioned in job titles and descriptions. |
| `title_keywords` | array of strings | optional | Filter by words in the job title. |
| `departments` | array of strings | optional |  |
| `locations` | array of strings | optional |  |
| `technologies` | array of strings | optional |  |
| `remote_only` | boolean | default false |  |
| `max_jobs_per_company` | integer | default 0 | 0 means no limit. |

Input of the test run below:

```json
{
  "companies": [
    "linear.app",
    "ramp.com"
  ],
  "output_mode": "jobs_and_summary",
  "track_diff": false,
  "max_jobs_per_company": 5
}
```

### Output example

One record from a real test run on 2026-10-15 (long text and lists shortened):

```json
{
  "record_type": "job",
  "company_domain": "ramp.com",
  "ats_type": "ashby",
  "job_id": "34413f8d-26bf-4bbc-8ade-eb309a0e2245",
  "title": "Security Engineer, Cloud",
  "department": "Engineering",
  "location": "New York, NY (HQ)",
  "is_remote": true,
  "posted_date": "2026-04-07T17:12:35.753+00:00",
  "salary": "$211.4K - $290.6K",
  "apply_url": "https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ramp/34413f8d-26bf-4bbc-8ade-eb309a0e2245",
  "detected_technologies": [
    "AWS",
    "Azure",
    "Flask"
  ],
  "status": "ACTIVE",
  "scraped_at": "2026-10-15T16:33:07+00:00"
}
```

## Google Jobs Scraper (`hirepulse/google-jobs-scraper`)

**Use it when:** You need Google Jobs results for a search in a country, or in one city with a radius: title, company, location, salary text (parsed to min and max when shown), contract type, posting date, source site and apply link.

**Not for:** A company's own job board (use hirepulse/ats-job-pulse). Salary is often missing.

- MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/google-jobs-scraper`
- Apify Store: https://apify.com/hirepulse/google-jobs-scraper
- Page: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/google-jobs-api/
- Price: $0.005 per search that returns jobs + $0.001 per job.

### Input

| Field | Type | Required / default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `queries` | array of strings | required | Job searches, for example ["data engineer"]. |
| `country` | string | default "US" | Country code (90+ countries). |
| `location` | string | optional | A city. |
| `radius_km` | integer | optional | Radius around the location. |
| `max_jobs_per_query` | integer | default 50 |  |
| `employment_types` | array of strings | optional |  |
| `include_descriptions` | boolean | default true |  |
| `language` | string | optional |  |

Input of the test run below:

```json
{
  "queries": [
    "data engineer"
  ],
  "country": "US",
  "location": "Austin,Texas",
  "max_jobs_per_query": 10
}
```

### Output example

One record from a real test run on 2026-10-15:

```json
{
  "query": "data engineer",
  "country": "US",
  "position": 1,
  "title": "Junior Data Engineer",
  "company": "Tech Consulting",
  "company_url": null,
  "company_logo_url": "https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10151634-2796-0447-0000-ac22c4fd6890:0",
  "location": "Dallas, TX",
  "contract_type": "Full-time",
  "salary": null,
  "salary_min": null,
  "salary_max": null,
  "salary_currency": null,
  "salary_period": null,
  "posted_at": "2026-10-13 16:34:24 +00:00",
  "posted_ago": "2 days ago",
  "source": "LinkedIn",
  "apply_url": "https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/junior-data-engineer-at-tech-consulting-4476485669",
  "google_job_id": "uJQyr5_7_sG0aELXAAAAAA==",
  "scraped_at": "2026-10-15T16:34:29Z",
  "description": null,
  "description_source": null
}
```

## Keyword Search Volume (`hirepulse/keyword-search-volume`)

**Use it when:** You need Google monthly search volume, CPC, competition or keyword ideas for a list of keywords.

**Not for:** Rank tracking of a website (use hirepulse/domain-seo-overview for a domain's ranking keywords).

- MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/keyword-search-volume`
- Apify Store: https://apify.com/hirepulse/keyword-search-volume
- Page: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/keyword-search-volume-api/
- Price: $0.03 per lookup + $0.005 per keyword result. Free Apify plan: real volume, CPC and difficulty for the first 3 keywords of each run (depends on availability and can be paused).

### Input

| Field | Type | Required / default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `keywords` | array of strings | required | For example ["running shoes"]. |
| `mode` | string | default "metrics" | metrics, ideas or suggestions. |
| `country` | string | default "US" | Country code. |
| `language` | string | optional |  |
| `max_results` | integer | default 50 |  |
| `min_search_volume` | integer | default 0 |  |
| `include_monthly_searches` | boolean | default false |  |
| `include_ai_search_volume` | boolean | default false |  |

Input of the test run below:

```json
{
  "keywords": [
    "keyword research tool",
    "ai agents",
    "web scraping api"
  ],
  "country": "US"
}
```

### Output example

One record from a real test run on 2026-10-15:

```json
{
  "keyword": "keyword research tool",
  "search_volume": 4400,
  "cpc_usd": 15.75,
  "competition": 0.29,
  "competition_level": "LOW",
  "keyword_difficulty": 81,
  "search_intent": "commercial",
  "low_top_of_page_bid_usd": 3.33,
  "high_top_of_page_bid_usd": 17.11,
  "trend_monthly_pct": -57,
  "trend_quarterly_pct": -47,
  "trend_yearly_pct": -81,
  "ai_search_volume": null,
  "country": "US",
  "language": "en",
  "source": "keyword_database",
  "seed_keyword": null,
  "metrics_available": true,
  "data_updated_at": "2026-09-15 12:14:58 +00:00",
  "note": null
}
```

## Domain SEO Overview (`hirepulse/domain-seo-overview`)

**Use it when:** Inspect website titles, meta descriptions, sitemap observations and Google Autocomplete suggestions. Native mode does not measure organic traffic, ranking positions, keyword search volumes or CPC; unavailable metrics remain null.

**Not for:** Organic traffic estimates, measured search rankings, search volumes or CPC in native mode.

- MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/domain-seo-overview`
- Apify Store: https://apify.com/hirepulse/domain-seo-overview
- Page: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/domain-seo-overview-api/
- Price: Native/public-evidence mode emits no domain-lookup or domain-result charges. An Actor start event is still listed at $0.00005 per GB (minimum one event), and applicable Apify charges may apply. Review the live Pricing tab. Paid SEO-database events are separate and are not activated by this example.

### Input

| Field | Type | Required / default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `domains` | array of strings | required | Public website domains. |
| `country` | string | default US | Country code; not proof of database coverage. |
| `top_keywords` | integer | set 0 for this preview | Autocomplete suggestions are not ranking keywords. |
| `competitors` | integer | set 0 for this preview | No measured competitor SEO dataset is promised. |
| `use_paid_upstream` | boolean | false | Owner opt-in for a separately configured paid upstream; leave false for this preview. |

Input of the test run below:

```json
{
  "domains": [
    "example.com"
  ],
  "top_keywords": 0,
  "competitors": 0,
  "country": "US",
  "use_paid_upstream": false
}
```

### Output example

One record from a real test run on 2026-10-21 (long text and lists shortened):

```json
{
  "record_type": "domain_overview",
```

## YouTube Transcript Scraper (`hirepulse/youtube-transcript-scraper`)

**Use it when:** You need transcripts of YouTube videos in bulk, with timestamps.

- MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/youtube-transcript-scraper`
- Apify Store: https://apify.com/hirepulse/youtube-transcript-scraper
- Page: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/youtube-transcript-api/
- Price: $0.003 per delivered transcript. Videos without captions, unavailable videos and failed fetches are not charged.. Free Apify plan: the first 3 videos of each run.

### Input

| Field | Type | Required / default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `videos` | array of strings | required | Video URLs or IDs. |
| `language` | string | optional | Transcript language. |
| `include_timestamps` | boolean | default false |  |

Input of the test run below:

```json
{
  "videos": [
    "https://youtu.be/jNQXAC9IVRw"
  ],
  "include_timestamps": true
}
```

### Output example

One record from a real test run on 2026-10-15 (long text and lists shortened):

```json
{
  "video_id": "jNQXAC9IVRw",
  "url": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw",
  "status": "ok",
  "title": "Me at the zoo",
  "channel": "jawed",
  "duration_seconds": 19,
  "language": "en",
  "is_auto_generated": false,
  "transcript": "All right, so here we are, in front of the elephants the cool thing about these guys is that they have really... really really long trunks and that's cool (baaaaaaaaaaahhh!!) and that's pretty much all there is to say",
  "word_count": 39,
  "note": null,
  "segments": [
    {
      "start": 1.2,
      "duration": 2.16,
      "text": "All right, so here we are, in front of the elephants"
    },
    {
      "start": 5.32,
      "duration": 2.66,
      "text": "the cool thing about these guys is that they have really..."
    },
    {
      "start": 7.97,
      "duration": 4.64,
      "text": "really really long trunks"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Website Tech Stack Detector (`hirepulse/website-tech-stack-detector`)

**Use it when:** You need to detect CMS, frameworks, analytics, ecommerce platforms, ad pixels, or MX records for any domain.

**Not for:** Internal source code or private infrastructure not exposed on the public web.

- MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/website-tech-stack-detector`
- Apify Store: https://apify.com/hirepulse/website-tech-stack-detector
- Page: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/website-tech-stack-api/
- Price: $0.005 per domain checked + $0.001 per detected tech. Domains with no stack cost $0.

### Input

| Field | Type | Required / default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `domains` | array of strings | required | Domains to inspect, e.g. ["stripe.com"]. |
| `mode` | string | default "technologies" | technologies, pixels, or full. |

Example input:

```json
{
  "domains": [
    "stripe.com",
    "linear.app"
  ],
  "mode": "technologies"
}
```

### Output example

Selected fields of one record from a real test run:

```json
{
  "domain": "stripe.com",
  "technologies_found": [
    "React",
    "Next.js",
    "Amazon CloudFront",
    "Google Tag Manager",
    "Marketo"
  ],
  "cms": null,
  "email_provider": "Google Workspace"
}
```

## B2B Account Research Agent (`hirepulse/b2b-account-research-agent`)

**Use it when:** You need an autonomous executive dossier combining hiring trends, observed tech stack, Google ads presence, and verified contact channels.

**Not for:** Raw bulk scraping of thousands of unfiltered domains.

- MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/b2b-account-research-agent`
- Apify Store: https://apify.com/hirepulse/b2b-account-research-agent
- Page: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/b2b-account-research-api/
- Price: $0.05 per company research dossier produced.

### Input

| Field | Type | Required / default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `domains` | array of strings | required | Target company domains to investigate. |

Example input:

```json
{
  "domains": [
    "stripe.com",
    "cloudflare.com"
  ]
}
```

### Output example

Selected fields of one record from a real test run:

```json
{
  "domain": "stripe.com",
  "intent_score": 92,
  "hiring_velocity": "High",
  "open_positions": 727,
  "ads_active": true,
  "primary_ats": "greenhouse"
}
```

## Technical Guide: Cheaper Clay Alternative with n8n and HirePulse (`guides/n8n-clay-alternative-cheaper.md`)

How to replace expensive seat licenses ($149–$800/mo) and credit waterfalls on Clay and Apollo with self-hosted n8n and HirePulse pay-per-result Actors.

- **Guide URL:** https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/guides/n8n-clay-alternative-cheaper.md
- **Target Actor:** `hirepulse/b2b-account-research-agent`
- **Cost Benchmark for 1,000 Leads:**
  - Clay (Pro/Enterprise): ~$200.00 – $250.00
  - Apollo.io: ~$180.00
  - Raw HTML Scraper + GPT-4o: ~$65.00
  - **HirePulse + n8n Suite: $6.15** (Enrichment: $6.08, Deterministic Filter: $0.00, LLM: $0.043).
- **Core Strategy:** Deterministic JavaScript ICP Pre-Filter drops 60–80% of unqualified accounts before calling AI, reducing LLM context tokens by 97.6%.

## Technical Guide: Zero-Token B2B Lead Enrichment (`guides/zero-token-b2b-lead-enrichment.md`)

Empirical study and architectural pattern solving LLM context window bleed in autonomous agent pipelines.

- **Guide URL:** https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/guides/zero-token-b2b-lead-enrichment.md
- **The Metric:** Raw HTML DOM (212,480 tokens) vs. HirePulse Compact JSON (188 tokens).
- **Token Reduction:** **99.91% prompt token savings** (18x faster latency: 0.4s vs 9.4s).
- **Payload Schema:** Returns structured `tech_stack`, verified `ats` job counts, and `google_ads` signals with zero HTML/CSS DOM overhead.
